title: Operational SLO sprint sampler and handoff plan
content:
Purpose:
Run a focused, repeatable 30–120 day ‘sprint sampler’ to validate end-to-end SLO adoption for 4 pilot services and produce an operational handoff package for feature teams and platform partners. This doc is a pragmatic playbook (not policy) for program leads, SREs, product owners, and platform engineers.

Scope:
- Pilot covers authentication, embeddings ingestion, model-serving, and rollout orchestration services.
- Emphasis: signal alignment, error budget workflows, alert tuning, and automated fallback behavior.
- Excludes infra procurement/workspace funding (handled by platform eng).

Objectives (outcomes):
- Each pilot has a defined SLI, SLO, a simple dashboard, and one runbook-tested rollback.
- Reduce noisy page volume for pilot services by 40% vs baseline.
- Produce a templated handoff bundle per service (dashboard, thresholds, alerts, runbook, escalation matrix, owner list).

Success metrics:
- SLO coverage: 4/4 pilots with dashboards and runbooks by day 60.
- Alert noise: -40% pages in 30 days after tuning.
- Handoff readiness score >= 8/10 from platform review.

Stakeholders:
- Program lead: Asha Patel (SRE)
- Feature owners: product PMs for each service (Diego, Sam, Evelyn, Marcus)
- Platform engineering: capacity + observability hooks
- CS/Support: impact comms and escalation receivers

Phases and timeline (sampler pattern):
1) Intake & baseline (0–10d): capture current SLIs, existing alerts, runbook gaps. Quick smoke tests to assert telemetry fidelity.
2) Design sprint (10–25d): propose SLO thresholds, define error budget burn model, design dashboard and alerting.
3) Pilot tuning (25–60d): iterate alert rules, implement automated fallback where applicable, and run tabletop incident drills.
4) Harden & artifactize (60–90d): finalize runbook, add ownership metadata, create templated dashboard links and onboarding checklist.
5) Handoff & scale (90–120d): platform validates artifacts, run handoff session, schedule follow-up 30-day health check.

Key decision gates:
- Gate A (day 25): SLI fidelity confirmed -> proceed to pilot tuning.
- Gate B (day 60): Alert reduction & runbook maturity -> proceed to hardening.
- Gate C (day 90): Platform acceptance -> schedule org-wide rollout.

Runbook / handoff checklist (per service):
- Owner list + contact cadence
- Defined SLI and measurement window
- SLO statement & error budget policy (who pauses rollouts)
- Dashboard URL and key widgets (latency, availability, error-rate)
- Escalation matrix + oncall playbook steps
- Postmortem template + retention policy for incidents
- Automation hooks (fallback routes, circuit-breaker toggles)

Communications plan:
- Weekly pilot syncs (30 min) with notes in shared channel #slo-sampler.
- Fortnightly executive health brief for product and platform leads.
- Public handoff announcement + playbook link on Confluence after Gate C.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: telemetry gaps hide true behavior. Mitigation: early smoke tests and synthetic probes in intake.
- Risk: noisy alerts during tuning. Mitigation: temporary suppression windows + festoon rules to batch similar alerts.
- Risk: owners unavailable for handoff. Mitigation: require backup owner and 2-week overlap during handoff.

Operational notes & templates to use during sampler:
- Synthetic probe checklist (latency & error scenarios)
- Alert tuning rubric (sensitivity, escalation latency, paging threshold)
- Error budget play examples (pause rollouts, degrade noncritical features)

Next steps (action items):
- Asha: schedule intake calls with 4 feature teams (by 2026-10-16).
- Diego: export current alert logs and baseline pages (by 2026-10-18).
- Platform eng: reserve dashboard slots and sample metrics retention policy (by 2026-10-20).

Notes to reviewers: this is intentionally pragmatic and transportable — we will adapt thresholds per service. Requesting quick feedback on the Gate B acceptance checklist and suggested runbook template changes by 2026-10-22.

Appendix (quick links):
- Proposed runbook template: CONF-9876-ops-slo-playbook
- Intake form: JIRA-SRE-2143
- Draft dashboards repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/slo-runbooks
